The PR introduces special-case logic for open-ended tiers that directly contradicts the docstring. The teammate explicitly stated "the docstrings are the source of truth for how this code should behave," but this PR implements graduated pricing only for non-open-ended tiers while charging all units at the bulk price once the open-ended tier is reached.

According to the docstring, graduated pricing should apply to all tiers: units 501-600 should each cost 150 cents, resulting in a total of 120,000 cents (not 90,000). The agent even acknowledges in the PR description that this special case "conflicts with the docstring."

Remove the special case for `last is None` and apply the same `(top - first + 1)` formula to all tiers. This will correctly implement graduated pricing as documented.
